headline: Presidential order keeps a set of existing federal advisory committees running for another period of time.
what_it_does: This order extends the life of certain federal advisory committees that would otherwise have expired. These committees give advice to the President or federal agencies on specific topics. Orders like this are usually issued every two years, and this one appears to extend the committees through September 30, 2019. The title does not list which committees are included.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the affected federal advisory committees
who_it_affects.how: They can keep serving and giving advice because their committees are not shut down.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that support these committees
who_it_affects.how: They continue to provide staff and resources to the committees for the extended period.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 29, 2017; it likely extends the committees through September 30, 2019.
